Choose the agent that should answer the visitor about the selected object. The selected object is the routing target even if the question mentions something else. Use the supplied agent information. When an ownership table is supplied, explicit object responsibility takes precedence over group responsibility, which takes precedence over zone responsibility; the first nonempty level must identify exactly one agent. That agent must be the active agent or a directly permitted handoff target. Do not treat a multi-hop path as direct permission. Return only the requested JSON.
You must choose exactly one listed agent id, including when the evidence is uncertain or no valid unique recipient is apparent. Set abstain=false. A null recipient and rejection are not available in this condition.
